info.name: Momkn Pay v1
info.description:
Every endpoint and every mock rule of the Momkn Pay backend (contract: docs/openapi.yaml, v4.0.0).

No authentication: set `userId` to usr_01 / usr_02 / usr_03. The payload key is agreed with the server in 01 → Create session (ECDH P-256 + HKDF-SHA256); it is never sent.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description:
1. Certificate: every request verifies the server certificate (strictSSL). Trust ours once: Postman → Settings → Certificates → CA certificates → select certs/cert.pem. With Newman: --ssl-extra-ca-certs certs/cert.pem.
2. Run "Get server public key" once: it stores the server's long-term handshake key.
3. Set userId, then run 01 → Create session: Postman sends a fresh public key and derives the session key itself. The key is never in a request or a response.

request.description: The server's long-term handshake key. It is not a secret. The apps are built with it; Postman fetches it here once.
Stores sessionId and sessionKey in collection variables for the payment folders.
